summary: Iteration 10: Tested custom task points + Loja de Efeitos (13 profile effects). Backend: 18/18 pytest tests passed (task points, on-time/late awards, uncomplete deduction, effects list/edit/buy/equip, profile propagation). Frontend: admin store shows 13 cards with only Equipar (no Comprar), edit-price dialog updates cost; admin can equip effects and the login profile-picker renders fx-avatar-wrapper.fx-golden around admin's avatar. Student store shows Saldo, Padrão + 12 Comprar buttons; buy flow deducts points and enables Equipar; equip persists. task-points-input rendered in admin TaskDialog and points=25 correctly stored & retrieved.

issues: Admin's owned effect card displays only 'Equipar' — the current cost is not visible on the card face; the price is only viewable inside the edit dialog. Consider showing 'Custo: N pts' near the pencil icon so admins see the value before editing.

action_items: (optional) Show current cost text on admin store cards (currently only editable via dialog).

(nice-to-have) Include task.points in task update payload so legacy tasks (created before this iteration) can retroactively have points assigned via the UI. Currently existing tasks return points=null and show no +N pts badge to students.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 2293 lines — recommend splitting into modules (auth/tasks/effects/ai) for maintainability (>700 lines guideline).
complete_task uses task.get('points') or 10 as fallback; that means legacy tasks with points=null award 10 (not 0). Confirm this is desired behaviour vs. awarding the stored value strictly.

buy_effect check `effect['id'] in owned or effect['id'] == 'none'` returns already_owned:true silently — good; but response omits current points for that branch. Consider returning current points too for UI parity.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows validated; task-points badge visual check not confirmed on visible tasks because seeded tasks have points=null)
